snippet.title: Panthalassa Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2955720/Panthalassa/

Itch.io Page: https://meiacalca.itch.io/panthalassa

Panthalassa is a Point and click and visual novel set in an underwater alien world. You play as an AI trying to uncover the memories of their body's previous owner. The game makes you experience the world through different user interfaces, where the physical and digital worlds collide.
